q: Which Bayern defender equalised in the last minute of extra time of the 1974 European Cup final, forcing a replay against Atlético?
sub: Bayern won the replay 4-0 two days later.
note: Schwarzenbeck equalised in the 120th minute on 15 May, Bayern won the replay 4-0 on 17 May: Wikipedia 1974 European Cup final.

q: Which Spanish club did Cristiano Ronaldo win four Champions Leagues with?
sub: 2014, 2016, 2017 and 2018. His first came with Manchester United in 2008.
note: Ronaldo helped Madrid win four Champions Leagues and won the 2008 title with United: Wikipedia Cristiano Ronaldo.

q: Which club did Lionel Messi win all four of his Champions Leagues with?
note: Messi's Champions League honours are 2005-06, 2008-09, 2010-11, 2014-15, all with Barcelona: Wikipedia Lionel Messi.

q: Who scored the winning penalty in the 2016 Champions League final shoot-out against Atlético Madrid?
note: Ronaldo took the fifth and decisive penalty: Wikipedia 2016 UEFA Champions League final.

q: Who managed Manchester United to the 2017 Europa League?
note: Mourinho's United won the 2017 final: Wikipedia 2017 UEFA Europa League final.

q: Which Frenchman opened the scoring for Manchester United against Ajax in the 2017 Europa League final?
sub: Henrikh Mkhitaryan got the second.
note: Pogba opened the scoring and Mkhitaryan got the second: Wikipedia 2017 UEFA Europa League final.

q: Which Brazilian scored Barcelona's third, in stoppage time, in the 2015 Champions League final against Juventus?
note: trimmed

q: Barcelona won the 2015 Champions League to complete a treble. In which earlier year had they done it the first time?
sub: The first European club to win the treble twice.
note: trimmed

q: Which two colours make up Galatasaray's home shirt?
note: Nicknamed the Yellow-Reds, Sarı-Kırmızılılar: Wikipedia Galatasaray S.K. football.

note: Panathinaikos won 1-0 at Ajax and lost 3-0 at home, 1995-96 semi-final: Wikipedia 1995-96 UEFA Champions League knockout stage.

q: In which city do Hearts play their home games at Tynecastle?
note: Hearts' ground is Tynecastle Park, Edinburgh: Wikipedia Heart of Midlothian F.C.

q: By the end of 2025-26, which Turkish club had won the most league titles, with 26?
note: Galatasaray's 2025-26 title was their 26th, more than any Turkish club: Milliyet, turkgun, Wikipedia.

q: In which city do Panathinaikos play?
note: Panathinaikos play in Athens, at the Athens Olympic Stadium: Wikipedia Panathinaikos F.C.

q: Sheriff Tiraspol shocked Real Madrid at the Bernabéu in 2021. Which country's league do they play in?
note: Sheriff Tiraspol play in the Moldovan Liga: Wikipedia FC Sheriff Tiraspol.

q: Bodø Glimt knocked Inter out of the Champions League in 2026. Which country are they from?
note: Bodø/Glimt are Norwegian, they beat Inter 3-1 and 2-1 in the February 2026 knockout play-off: Flashscore, beIN, Malay Mail.

q: APOEL reached the Champions League quarter-finals in 2012. Which country are they from?
note: APOEL of Nicosia, Cyprus, first Cypriot club in the Champions League quarter-finals in 2011-12: Wikipedia APOEL FC.

q: Which English club won the 2019 Super Cup in Istanbul, beating Chelsea on penalties?
note: Liverpool beat Chelsea on penalties at Vodafone Park, Istanbul: Wikipedia 2019 UEFA Super Cup.

note: Man City beat Sevilla 5-4 on penalties at the Karaiskakis Stadium, Piraeus: Wikipedia 2023 UEFA Super Cup.

note: Real Madrid 2-0 Atalanta in Warsaw: Wikipedia 2024 UEFA Super Cup.

note: Mbappé opened the scoring in the 37th minute of the 3-0 win at Lusail: Wikipedia 2024 FIFA Intercontinental Cup final. Reworded the clumsy 'scored first for Real Madrid in his first season there'.

q: Wilfried Nancy lasted about a month as Celtic manager, from December 2025. Which club beat them 3-1 in the League Cup final during his spell?
note: Nancy appointed 3 December 2025, sacked 5 January 2026: Sky Sports, beIN. St Mirren 3-1 Celtic, League Cup final, Hampden, 14 December 2025, Ayunga twice: Wikipedia 2025 Scottish League Cup final, Sky, AP via AOL. Reworded 'one month, December 2025', he was in post into January.

q: Celtic won the 2026 Scottish Cup final 3-1 at Hampden. Which club did they beat?
note: Celtic 3-1 Dunfermline, 23 May 2026, Hampden, Maeda, Engels, Iheanacho: Scottish FA, Data Sports Group, Sky Germany.

q: Saarbrücken played in the first European Cup in 1955-56. Which long-gone territory did they represent?
sub: The only club ever to represent the Saar in the European Cup.
note: Saarbrücken entered the 1955-56 European Cup for the Saar, the only UEFA tournament to include a Saarland representative: Wikipedia 1955-56 European Cup. Sub narrowed to the European Cup, the safer claim.
